name: Mam cai
summary: Mắm cái is the dipping bowl. The 24 Feb 2025 sanctuary essay traces it to Cham seafarers who salted fish. On 7 Feb 2025 the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism says the Quảng Nam bowl and Huế mắm nêm are both salty and do not smell the same.
origin: The communes around My Son in the sanctuary essay, and Quảng Nam in the 7 Feb 2025 ministry article.
history: The sanctuary essay says the bowl comes from Cham people who salted fish before going to sea, and that central Vietnamese cooking uses fish sauce where another region would set out soy.
taste: The ministry article, citing Báo Văn hóa, says a jar of Huế mắm nêm and a bowl of Quảng Nam mắm cái share a salty taste, and the aroma is different enough that a practiced eater can tell them apart.
howToEat: Neither account prints a recipe. The price is Check on arrival.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Neither account names a stall. Check on arrival.
